code='''def transform(grid):
    rows = [i for i, row in enumerate(grid) if len(set(row)) == 1]
    cols = [j for j in range(len(grid[0])) if all(row[j] == grid[0][j] for row in grid)]
    # Separators are uniform rows/columns; the non-separator color occurring sparsely is the signal.
    row_bounds = [-1] + rows + [len(grid)]
    col_bounds = [-1] + cols + [len(grid[0])]
    colors = {v for row in grid for v in row}
    sep_colors = {grid[i][0] for i in rows} | {grid[0][j] for j in cols}
    signal = next(c for c in colors - sep_colors if sum(v == c for row in grid for v in row) < len(grid)*len(grid[0])//2)
    out=[]
    for ra, rb in zip(row_bounds, row_bounds[1:]):
        if rb == ra+1: continue
        line=[]
        for ca, cb in zip(col_bounds, col_bounds[1:]):
            if cb == ca+1: continue
            n=sum(grid[r][c] == signal for r in range(ra+1,rb) for c in range(ca+1,cb))
            line.append(1 if n==2 else 6)
        out.append(line)
    return out
'''

code='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    sep_rows = [i for i, row in enumerate(grid) if len(set(row)) == 1]
    sep_cols = [j for j in range(w) if all(grid[i][j] == grid[0][j] for i in range(h))]
    rb = [-1] + sep_rows + [h]
    cb = [-1] + sep_cols + [w]
    separators = {grid[i][0] for i in sep_rows} | {grid[0][j] for j in sep_cols}
    counts = {}
    for a,b in zip(rb,rb[1:]):
        if b == a+1: continue
        for x,y in zip(cb,cb[1:]):
            if y == x+1: continue
            for r in range(a+1,b):
                for c in range(x+1,y):
                    v=grid[r][c]
                    if v not in separators: counts[v]=counts.get(v,0)+1
    signal=max(counts, key=counts.get)
    common=max((v for v in counts if v != signal), key=counts.get, default=signal)
    out=[]
    for a,b in zip(rb,rb[1:]):
        if b == a+1: continue
        line=[]
        for x,y in zip(cb,cb[1:]):
            if y == x+1: continue
            n=sum(grid[r][c] == signal for r in range(a+1,b) for c in range(x+1,y))
            line.append(1 if n == 2 else common)
        out.append(line)
    return out
'''
pfile.write_text(code)
exec(code)
print(transform(g))
